# Google Cloud Professional Agentic Architect (PAA)

> Self-contained study material for one exam. Dense long-form markdown
> reference: comparison matrices, decision trees, exam traps, and
> practice questions with full option-by-option explanations.
>
> Scope note: this index covers this folder only. Other exam folders in
> this repository are independent and have their own llms.txt.

Agents: read CLAUDE.md in this folder (identical to GEMINI.md and
AGENTS.md) before making changes.

## Index

- [Folder index](README.md): reading order and mental map

## Core reference

- [Start here](00-START-HERE/): core reference material, written in
  full, including a consolidated A-Z glossary

## Full reference (written in full, 2026-08-28 bulk-generation pass)

- [Domains](01-domains/): one deep-dive per exam section
- [Services](02-services/): all 28 in-scope tools, grouped by function
- [Comparisons](03-comparisons/): head-to-head decision matrices
- [Architectures](04-architectures/): production architecture patterns
- [Labs](05-labs/): per-section walkthroughs plus a flagship
  ground-zero-to-complete capstone project
- [Practice](06-practice/): per-section question banks and mock exams
- [Revision](07-revision/): compressed cheatsheets, flashcards, and an
  exam-day checklist
- [Interview](08-interview/): architect-level scenario and
  behavioral/tradeoff questions
- [Assets](09-assets/): consolidated diagrams, mind maps, decision
  flowcharts
